title: KTP Transaction Record v3
description: Unreleased v3 Trajectory Chain record. The exact record and staged signing contract are defined in specifications/trajectory-signatures.md. Every accepted field participates in the specified agent payload, Oracle payload, or completed-record hash; no unsigned extension fields exist outside the explicitly signed action.details object. This schema constrains shape, ranges, and chain-start conditions. Canonical JSON, finite and representable numbers, cryptographic signatures, trusted keys and profiles, migration authority, chain continuity, and Oracle commit evidence require semantic and runtime verification. The byte-preserved historical v2 schema is transaction-record-legacy-v2.json and does not define v3 acceptance.

sequence.description: Zero-based position within this authenticated chain. Semantic verification also requires a JSON integer token and exact continuity with the verified predecessor.

previous_hash.description: Null only for sequence zero. Otherwise the digest of the verified immediately preceding completed v3 record; same-chain continuity is a semantic obligation.

friction.description: Environmental friction at the time of the action; included in the authenticated record body.

velocity.description: Agent transaction rate at the time of the action, included in the authenticated body. This is the record's own rate field; it is not the trust_trend Risk Factor. Semantic validation rejects nonfinite and nonrepresentable JSON numbers.

conformance_level.description: Claimed conformance level bound by the signatures. A record cannot select a weaker level than the trusted deployment requires; declaration shape alone does not prove conformance.

evaluation_profile_digest.description: Digest of the exact authenticated evaluation profile used for this record. Level 3 requires SHA-384; the trusted deployment controls the required profile and cryptographic strength.

migration_checkpoint.description: Null for ordinary genesis and every successor. A legacy migration starts a new v3 chain at sequence zero and binds its independently authenticated migration checkpoint digest. A nonnull digest alone does not authorize migration.

agent_signature.description: Compact JWS for the agent signing stage defined by specifications/trajectory-signatures.md. The stage excludes its derived signature envelope, the later Oracle attestation, and record_hash. Shape does not verify the protected header, payload, signature, or trusted signer.

record_hash.description: Digest of the completed v3 signed-record bytes defined by specifications/trajectory-signatures.md, excluding only the derived record_hash field. Both signature envelopes and every Oracle attestation field are covered. Level 3 requires SHA-384.

literalId.description: Exact nonempty identifier without whitespace or wildcard characters.

utcTimestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with uppercase T and Z, seconds and optional one-to-six fractional digits. Leap-second spellings are unsupported and rejected. Calendar validity requires format assertions; trusted-time and ordering checks remain separate.

compactJws.description: Compact JWS with three nonempty, unpadded base64url segments. Decoding, canonical payload equality, protected-header requirements, approved algorithms, cryptographic verification, and key authorization are separate mandatory checks.

lineage.description: Lineage stage, derived from generation; consistency requires semantic verification.

generation.description: Nonnegative generation within the exact integer range supported by canonical JSON; semantic validation also requires an integer token.

details.description: Operation-specific JSON object. Every key and recursively nested value is included in the canonical signed payload; this is not an unsigned extension channel. Duplicate keys, nonfinite or nonrepresentable numbers, and non-JSON values are rejected before canonicalization.

risk_factors.description: The exact six Risk Factor inputs from the existing v2 Risk Factors schema. All six inputs are covered by the Oracle signing stage and completed-record hash; finite values and the required deterministic evaluation must be verified.

oracle_signature.description: Compact JWS for the Oracle signing stage defined by specifications/trajectory-signatures.md. Its payload is the canonical object {record_body: B, agent_signature: exact compact JWS, attestation: O}, where B is the agent record body and O contains oracle_id, attestation_time, and risk_factors. It excludes the derived Oracle signature envelope and record_hash. A valid signature does not replace required mesh commit evidence.
